snippet.title: 12 Hours Museum // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027850/12_Hours_Museum/

12 Hours Museum” is a 3D exploration adventure game. The goal of the game is to find 45 anomalies in order to escape from the museum using a pocket watch. Once you find an anomaly, you can view and re-experience it. Collecting all endings and performing certain operations will open an extra mode.

Developed by
YTCRAFT
